title: Investment Overview
description: Where your investments stand: how much you put in, what it's worth now, unrealized gain, income, allocation, and value over time.

widgets.title: Invested
widgets.helpText: The cost basis of the holdings you held as of the selected date — what you paid for them.

widgets.title: Current Value
widgets.helpText: Market value of your holdings as of the selected date. Click to see the holdings behind it.

widgets.title: Unrealized Gain
widgets.helpText: Current market value minus cost basis, as of the selected date. Green if up, red if down. Click to see per-holding gains.

widgets.title: Investment Income
widgets.helpText: Dividends and interest earned to date (cumulative), with this year's so far below. Click for the income breakdown.

steps.query: SELECT :currency AS currency, ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN transaction_date <= :asOf THEN CAST(amount AS REAL) ELSE 0 END) * -1, 2) AS amount, ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN transaction_date >= (strftime('%Y', :asOf) || '-01-01') AND transaction_date <= :asOf THEN CAST(amount AS REAL) ELSE 0 END) * -1, 2) AS ytd FROM postings WHERE (account LIKE 'Income:Dividends%' OR account LIKE 'Income:Interest%') AND currency = :currency HAVING amount != 0

widgets.title: Allocation
widgets.helpText: Current market value by asset class (inner ring) broken out to each holding (outer ring). Click a segment to zoom in.

steps.query: SELECT account, value FROM (SELECT COALESCE(c.asset_class, 'unclassified') || ':' || h.code AS account, ROUND(CASE WHEN pa.price IS NOT NULL THEN h.units * pa.price ELSE h.cost_basis END, 2) AS value FROM (SELECT p.currency AS code, SUM(CAST(p.amount AS REAL)) AS units, SUM(CAST(p.amount AS REAL) * COALESCE(CAST(p.cost_amount AS REAL), 0)) AS cost_basis FROM postings p JOIN commodities c ON c.code = p.currency AND c.is_currency = 0 WHERE p.transaction_date <= :asOf GROUP BY p.currency) h JOIN commodities c ON c.code = h.code LEFT JOIN (SELECT base_currency, CAST(quote_number AS REAL) AS price FROM prices x WHERE x.quote_currency = :currency AND x.date = (SELECT MAX(date) FROM prices y WHERE y.base_currency = x.base_currency AND y.quote_currency = :currency AND y.date <= :asOf)) pa ON pa.base_currency = h.code WHERE h.units > 0) WHERE value > 0 ORDER BY value DESC

widgets.title: Value Over Time
widgets.helpText: Monthly market value against what you put in (cost basis). Months where a holding had no recorded price fall back to cost.

widgets.title: Returns by Asset Class
widgets.helpText: XIRR is your money-weighted annual return — it accounts for when you invested. Simple gain ignores timing. Both are shown per asset class.
